title: Usage across a transcript tree, by tool, command and file
goal: kbusage.py reads a session transcript with its subagents/*.jsonl, or a whole project directory, and prints tool-result characters and calls grouped by tool, Bash command head and file path, with totals checked against the transcripts' own usage

gates.question: Which data does the rollup read?
options: transcripts, with OpenTelemetry tool_result events as an optional cross-check

notes: Baseline census: tool results of 314 transcripts of this project (52 sessions, 262 subagent runs), about 4 characters a token; each result is also re-read from cache on every later turn of its session. 92 ad-hoc reads of .jsonl transcripts and 122 scripts touching usage; the census behind this epic was itself hand-written. kbusage.py covers one transcript and one prompt; ST-6bi7oe6y and ST-mn4j4fis roll usage up by item and work window, not by tool or file. Kb facts: public/claude/otel-monitoring.md:18 (DOC S744), public/claude/agent-sdk.md:68,75 (modelUsage covers subagents; subagent transcripts, DOC S-isqfh6pr S-gztpah4d), public/claude/hooks.md:39 (transcript_path, DOC S743). It measures the other stories of EP-hsyx42zz.
